title: IN Realty
intro: An independent real estate brokerage serving the Research Triangle region of North Carolina. IN Realty delivers a more personal, service-driven approach to buying and selling, supported by a knowledgeable team and in-house expertise across every stage of the process.
secondary: As a new entrant in a competitive real estate market, IN Realty needed a brand that could establish credibility quickly while differentiating itself from larger, more impersonal brokerages.
